before.evidence: Read all five steps and nine supplier statements; compared full Brion Proposition 2.7.1 proof, https://arxiv.org/html/1509.03059v3#S2.SS7, lines 697–717. Field-flat kernels define a coherent scheme image, and product schematic dominance forces a subgroup. Dense constructible closed-point image contains a dense open on all components; intersecting translates gives all closed points, and constructibility gives topological surjectivity. A trivial scheme kernel makes a monomorphism with reduced singleton geometric fibres; Zariski Main plus closure gives finiteness generically. Source-lifted translations cover the target and give finiteness after algebraic closure; properness of the open source in the finite factor eliminates the boundary and descends finiteness. Finite fibre algebra D tensor D=D has dimension 0 or 1; finite cokernel Nakayama gives the closed immersion. Rational-point kernels alone are not used. Unchanged item/manifest hashes; contract boundary correction is audit enrichment. No defect found.

before.evidence: Read eight steps and all sixteen suppliers; fetched/read complete SGA3 VIA Theorem 3.2 and finite-type proof 3.2.1–3.2.5, printed pp.313–317, https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~patrick.polo/SGA3/Exp6A-13oct24.pdf (PDF pp.21–25). Coset relation is closed and both maps flat finitely presented. Quotientable saturated opens glue; a finite residue extension and translations cover rational points, and successive finite extensions strictly lower the dimension of the remaining complement until all G_K is quotientable. The diagonal descends from the closed relation via affine descent and faithful cokernel vanishing. Finite sets in Y gain affine neighbourhoods by translated dense opens after splitting all selected lifts, followed by the finite-relation saturation/norm construction; the proof works for a finite union of orbits. Full double/triple tensor-algebra descent, including inseparable nilpotents, yields Q. Normality gives operations by fppf representatives; exact kernel pair supplies the torsor, universal homomorphism property and field base-change compatibility. Smooth G makes every geometric Q reduced by faithful injection, then translation gives smoothness; smooth H makes q smooth by its geometric torsor fibres. No reducedness of H is assumed. Item/manifest pre/post agree; boundary enrichment only. No defect found. before.evidence: Read both steps and five reviewed suppliers. The scheme kernel quotient G/K maps into H with trivial kernel by fppf lifting; the closed immersion supplied by the monomorphism lemma and faithful schematic dominance of G→G/K identify it with the exact scheme image. Thus image normality is scheme theoretic, not only on rational points. Item/manifest pre/post hashes agree; boundary audit enrichment only. No defect found.
